title: Free GPU bake-off
hypothesis: The same torch + whisper-tiny script gets different cards, cold-start times, and throughput from each free surface — so 'free GPU' is not one thing. Kaggle hands out T4 or P100 by accelerator request; Colab's T4 entitlement is the open High risk this week either confirms or kills.
success_metric: One timings.json per lane (Kaggle T4, Kaggle P100, Colab T4-or-CPU) with a non-null gpu name, comparable fp16 matmul metric, and a whisper block (pip_s, load_s, transcribe_s, rtf) — harvested with no browser.

gpu.gate: lab.quota.decide_gpu_job -- 1h of an 8h session cap; week reads 0.01h/30.00h at W2 start
gpu.colab: colab run --gpu T4 (entitlement unverified; fallback CPU lane keeps the table at three rows)

eval.dataset: 5 items: emit a valid kernel-metadata.json for a T4 script kernel, flip is_private, name the GPU key, convert 1.5h and 8h budgets to -t seconds. Deterministic JSON/regex grading (no LLM judge).
eval.why: Same four models as W0's hello-proxy so the harder structured-output task is comparable against the riddle floor. A hosted model either writes metadata that would actually push, or it does not.
eval.limit: two models per kaggle b t run (AGENTS.md); solo gpt-oss-20b first to validate the task, then 2 + 1. estimated_usd uses W0's measured $/item x 5 items x ~50x JSON-output headroom
